questions.skill: Find the exterior surface area of a solid made of right prisms
questions.prompt: Two cubes with 2 cm edges are joined face to face. Find the exterior surface area of the solid. (The faces where the cubes touch are hidden and are not counted.)

Two cubes with 2 cm edges are joined face to face.

questions.skill: Find the exterior surface area of a solid made of right prisms
questions.prompt: A cube with 2 m edges sits on top of a 6 m by 6 m by 2 m prism. Its bottom face lies completely on the top face of the prism. Find the exterior surface area. (Do not count the faces where the solids touch.)
questions.prompt_markup:
A cube with 2 m edges sits on top of a 6 m by 6 m by 2 m prism. Its bottom face lies completely on the top face of the prism.
Find the exterior surface area. (Do not count the faces where the solids touch.)
questions.grading_note: The prism has 120 square meters, minus the 4 square meters covered by the cube, plus 5 faces of the cube (20 square meters).
